findings.item: Item 7: identifiers added by the variants
findings.detail: The collision tables come from base-block products. The variants add identifiers to module scope: _som_construct and _som_registry (orm.base.self), _SomBeanieSdkDocument (v6 Mongo), _som_match (v7). Only v1-v4 resource and field names can start with an underscore. For them, orm.base.self's Base is created before any model class, so a later resource class named _som_construct or _som_registry cannot affect the registry, and a field of that name is class-scoped. I found no reachable collision. Recording it here so future table derivations include variant products.

The rule has no slot for v7 flow names, step names or inputs. Inputs are emitted as generated variables (input_{index}) with Field(alias=...), and flow and step names are emitted as literals. They are therefore not Python identifiers, so no slot is missing. The spike's spot-003 also reports that self works in these positions.

The historical compiler acceptance tools that call qa_harness.verify_freeze bind the receipt chain only up to amendment 002 and were not re-run. probe-summary-001.json records them under not_run. Not a blocker. The compiler fixtures are covered by cargo test, which the probe reports as 42 passed and 0 failed; I did not re-run it.
